    expenses = []
    lines = content.split('\n')
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line.startswith('- '):
            continue
        # Pattern: - Payer paid $amount for "description". Owed equally by list.
        m = re.match(r'^- (\w+) paid \$(\d+) for "([^"]+)"\. Owed equally by (.+)\.$', line)
        if m:
            payer = m.group(1)
            amount = float(m.group(2))
            desc = m.group(3)
            debtors_str = m.group(4)

            debtors = [d.strip() for d in debtors_str.split(',') if d.strip()]
            expenses.append({'payer': payer, 'amount': amount, 'description': desc, 'debtors': debtors})
